notes: The timing engine and file set are bench/host_segments.py's: measure_segment_styles, measure_layer_sequence, nsys_capture_sequences, measure_extra_defs, count_extras_and_write and write_e11a_tables are the same functions the LeRobot E11a runs call, so the numbers are comparable with pi0's rather than produced by a second harness.

Both kinds of DiT block are measured, first and middle of each: AlternateVLDiT.forward (dit.py:381-403) runs odd blocks as self-attention and even blocks as cross-attention onto the backbone features (text tokens when idx % (2*attend_text_every_n_blocks) == 0, image tokens otherwise). Variants carry block=<i>;kind=<kind>.

The attention is NOT split into score / softmax / context (one fused SDPA kernel); the feed-forward is reported whole. Both are excluded from the host sequence, as the Gemma models' attention matmuls and large linears are (protocol §13.2).

Per-step extras re-run the model's own modules on arguments captured from one real denoising step (segments_groot.StepExtrasCapture); state_encoder runs once per inference, the rest once per step. Those that are large linear layers on the S tokens are marked large_linear_on_S=yes in segments.csv and are not host segments.
achieved_bw_GBps / achieved_tflops are published from the cudagraph style's gpu_event time only, as for the LeRobot models (eager gpu_event brackets a dispatch-bound call).
